implementation_summary: Original BE-101 work: safeGet gains allowPrivate (resolved once per hop, pinned, every hop re-checked) and redirectAsResponse; caller headers other than Accept/Accept-Language/User-Agent are dropped on a cross-origin redirect. makeOutboundFetch(opts) returns the checkers' FetchFn: GET only, body cap (over-cap returns status with empty body), timeout, headers, redirect limit; private addresses only when opts.allowPrivate !== false and getBrowserPolicy() === null, checked per call. sameSiteUrl helper. Spider robots/sitemap seeding uses the injectable outboundFetch; other-host Sitemap: lines and <loc>s are logged and skipped. RobotsPolicy.fetch takes a FetchFn defaulting to makeOutboundFetch({ allowPrivate: false }). contextFetcher sends context cookies through makeOutboundFetch with maxRedirects 0. REC-004 fix: timing probes (since removed) showed the overrun was click exploration started before the deadline (1.58 s to 8.29 s on one page), not seeding (75 ms) or browser start-up. deterministic-spider.ts now cuts every step to the time left (timeLeft/capToDeadline/navLimits): page-load timeout, settle wait and retries; pacing delay; click, waitForURL and settle waits; reloads; the click loop and interactive-state/CRUD exploration stop at the deadline; seeding fetch timeouts are capped and seeding is skipped when no time is left. Loads that hit the deadline are recorded as 'time-limit', and stopping at the deadline is not counted as an exploration error.

packages/core/src/discovery/deterministic-spider.ts: timeLeft/capToDeadline/navLimits helpers after the deadline setup; deadline checks in waitForPacing, evaluatePage navigation, click loop, interactive-state exploration and sitemap seeding
risks: exploreInteractiveStates (packages/core/src/discovery/interactive-states.ts, not owned) has its own click waits; if it starts just before the deadline those waits are not cut, so a small overrun is still possible there.
Near the deadline a page loads with a shorter settle wait and no retry, so a page loaded in the last moments may show fewer links; loads cut short by the deadline are recorded as 'time-limit'.
Spider sitemap/robots fetches carry customHeaders but not browser-context cookies; a sitemap served only to signed-in users will not seed.
A body over the cap returns an empty body: robots.txt over 512 KB becomes allow-all; an access-check page over 2 MB is judged on status only.
safeGet drops caller headers other than Accept/Accept-Language/User-Agent on a cross-origin redirect hop.
spider-sitemap-outbound.test.ts launches Chromium but runs in the |unit| vitest project (vitest.workspace.ts, not owned).
handoff: CHK-BE-101-SPIDER should now pass: the timing test takes about 2.1 s with a 2000 ms limit. Deadline handling lives in deterministic-spider.ts (timeLeft/capToDeadline/navLimits). For BE-104: build the checkers' fetchFn with makeOutboundFetch({ maxRedirects: 0, timeoutMs: 3000 }) and use sameSiteUrl; allowPrivate is derived inside makeOutboundFetch from getBrowserPolicy() at call time. ADR 0031's 'Not covered: RobotsPolicy.fetch' line is now stale and needs a docs update.
